# Repository Initialization Routine

Provides a single entry point to initialize a knowledge-compiler repository: it ensures the database schema is up-to-date, writes a kc.toml configuration file, and registers the repository in the database. This streamlines bringing a source repository under the management of the knowledge compiler, preparing all required artifacts and config.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/bootstrap.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.bootstrap.init_repository`
